# Lucid Dream — Architecture Visualization Studio
> Lucid Dream is a premier architecture visualization studio crafting CGI stills, films, real-time rendering, and brand storytelling for architects and design firms across India since 2012.
## Overview
- Website: https://luciddream.co.in
- Studio: Architecture Visualization, Animation, Real-time CG
- Location: Chennai & Pune, India
## Key Pages & Portfolio
- [Works](https://luciddream.co.in/#works): Selected architecture visualization portfolio items and case studies
- [Clients](https://luciddream.co.in/#clients): Architecture firms and developers partnered with Lucid Dream
- [About](https://luciddream.co.in/about): Studio capabilities, multidisciplinary practice, and team philosophy
